Name: Dialogue Emotes
Author: purrplingcat
Description:
This mod was created just for fun. Adds emotes from NPC dialogues above their head based on their dialogue portrait while they are talking like in Animal Crossing. It's simple to use. Just install this mod nad when any NPC talks, then you can see the emote above their head if they are happy, sad, loved or etc.

In the core it's supported basic emotes like $h, $s, $l and etc. If you want to define emotes for some special portraits for custom NPCs, you can do it via create a content pack.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]How to use[/size]
It's just simple mod for fun which adds only the above-head emotes while talking. Just talk with an NPC. In some dialogues NPC can react with emote above their head (if their dialogue text contains dialogue commands described bellow)

[list]
[*]Supports classic emotes: heart for [code]$l[/code], smile for [code]$h[/code], tear for [code]$s[/code] and hate for [code]$a[/code].
[*]For question dialogues is shown question mark above NPC head.
[*]With expansion content packs you can add some extra individual emotes based on face emotions for vanilla NPCs or for custom NPCs
[*]You can define customized emotes based on dialogue face emotions for each NPC with content packs
[*]Also it works without any content pack for basic emotes if NPCs are loved, happy, sad or hate.
[/list]
Requires [b][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/b], does not use Harmony.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.4 and 1.5 on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer.
[*]Android compatibility was not officially tested.
[/list]
If there is any problem, contact me on [url=https://npcadventures.dev/discord]my discord server[/url]﻿, or on official SDV discord server in channel #making-mods or #using-mods. Thanks.

[size=5]Create content pack[/size]

[spoiler]
Since version 1.1.0 Dialogue Emotes supports content packs with custom emotes for NPCs. For define custom emotes create standard [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Content_packs]SMAPI content pack[/url] and then create file [code]emotes.json
[/code]inside your pack directory which has content in following format:

[code]﻿{
  "Abigail": { // NPC name
    "$u": 40, // Dialogue emotion string: emote above head index
    "$7": 16, // Explicit emotion frame id: emote above head index
  }
}[/code]
[/spoiler]

Downloads.Description:
[b]MAIN MOD![/b] This mod adds support for dialogue emote bubbles about NPC's amhead and support for basic emotes ($h, $s, $l, $a) for all friendly NPCs (original and custom NPCs)

Unzip it to your Mods folder in StardewValley installation directory.
